info.name: RocketReach Account People Data API API

params.name: current_employer
params.description:
Current employer of the desired profile. Must specify along with `name`.
- Example: `RocketReach`

params.name: email
params.description:
An email address for the desired profile.
- Example: `jamie@rocketreach.co`

params.name: id
params.description:
RocketReach internal unique profile ID.
- Example: `123456`

params.name: linkedin_ext_url
params.description: linkedin_ext_url deprecated, please use `linkedin_url` instead

params.name: linkedin_url
params.description:
LinkedIn URL of the desired profile.
- Example: `www.linkedin.com/in/jamesgullbrand`

params.name: lookup_type
params.description:
Lookup type for the request

* `standard` - standard
* `premium` - premium
* `premium (feeds disabled)` - premium (feeds disabled)
* `bulk` - bulk
* `phone` - phone
* `enrich` - enrich

params.name: name
params.description:
Name of the desired profile. Must specify along with `current_employer`.
- Example: `Jamie Gullbrand`

params.name: npi_number
params.description:
An NPI number for the desired profile (US healthcare professional).
- Example: `1234567890`

params.name: return_cached_emails
params.description: Controls whether cached emails are included in the initial response when `lookup status = progress`. When set to `false`, all email fields will be null until the lookup is complete and all emails are fully verified. Use /checkStatus or Webhooks to retrieve the completed response with fully verified emails (`status = complete`). Defaults to `true`. NOTE: Default will change to false on September 1st, 2026. No cached emails will be returned in the initial response. Use /checkStatus or webhooks to retrieve fully verified emails.

params.name: title
params.description:
Job title of the desired profile.
- Example: `Product Manager`

params.name: webhook_id
params.description: Your webhook's unique ID number. Find it in your API Usage & Settings page.

params.name: ids
params.description: List of Profile IDs
